scientific_queries.note: Upper end of the decay curve via key-level holdout, plus a direct check of how pathway relates to drug identity.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round explains its own exact zero instead of dismissing it, and finds a feature-algebra fact.

the_zero_is_algebraic_not_dead.observation: identical predictions from both arms, rho 0.3774 each, gain exactly zero
the_zero_is_algebraic_not_dead.checked_in_the_data: each drug maps to exactly one pathway level: 46 anchor drugs and 65 library drugs, zero drugs with more than one level
the_zero_is_algebraic_not_dead.why: the pathway one-hots are a deterministic function of the drug one-hots, so the added block spans no new directions and ridge cannot use it
the_zero_is_algebraic_not_dead.conclusion: not a dead arm but a fact about the features

what_this_reframes.old_reading: the pathway annotation carries information beyond drug identity
what_this_reframes.correct_reading: the annotation is a coarsening of identity: useless when identity is available, and the only channel when it is not

unifies.the_six_times_decay: the gain tracks how much of the identity block is missing
unifies.the_both_unseen_concentration: identity columns are all zero there, so the coarsening is the only signal
unifies.the_pathway_versus_tissue_muddle: both are coarsenings, one of the drug and one of the cell, so neither was independent evidence

what_this_reframes.what_it_costs: the result is no longer a knowledge-augmentation finding but a cold-start fallback finding, which is a smaller claim than it looked

the_decay_curve_complete.reading: monotone in how much identity is missing, with a hard zero at the full-information end

limits: holding out keys still leaves the same combination observed in other cells
the exact zero depends on the linear one-hot ridge setting; a tree model or one with interactions might still extract something from the coarsening, and that is untested
retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI
next_gates: test whether the coarsening stays fully redundant under a nonlinear model on the same key-level holdout
